description: This PHP source file handles various wireless network configuration actions for a device, including login session validation, WiFi radio and SSID configuration, WPS setup, MAC filtering, and network parameter updates. It includes multiple functions to validate input, read and modify configuration parameters, and respond with JSON data for AJAX requests.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the WPS PIN checksum, supporting 4 or 8 digit PIN codes.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filter parameters, ensuring device names contain printable characters and MAC addresses are valid.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Triggers a configuration apply for a specific SSID by setting its apply parameter.
